meta.name: taobao-product-reviews
meta.description: Fetch customer reviews for a Taobao or Tmall product by itemId, returning reviewer name, date, purchased variant, review text, and photo URLs. Use when user asks to get product reviews from Taobao, scrape Taobao customer feedback, extract buyer reviews by item ID, collect Tmall ratings and comments, 采集淘宝商品评价, 抓取淘宝买家评论, 获取淘宝商品评论, 天猫商品评价抓取, 按商品ID获取评价. Also applies to sentiment analysis of product reviews, building review datasets, and monitoring product rating changes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按商品ID获取淘宝或天猫的买家评价
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在淘宝或天猫上批量获取商品评价数据。
copy.tagline_en: Fetch customer reviews for Taobao or Tmall products by item ID
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to batch retrieve product reviews from Taobao or Tmall.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据商品 ID 抓取淘宝或天猫的买家评论，返回用户名、日期、购买规格、评论文本和图片链接。
howto.when: 当你要求获取淘宝商品评论、采集评价、按商品 ID 提取买家反馈，或进行评论情感分析、构建评论数据集时触发。

say.text: 帮我查一下这个淘宝商品的评论，ID 是 123456789。
say.note: Claude 会打开商品页并提取评论。

say.text: 抓取这个天猫商品的买家评价，我要看最新的 10 条。
say.note: Claude 会翻页获取多页评论。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can fetch customer reviews for a Taobao or Tmall product by item ID, returning username, date, purchased variant, review text, and photo URLs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to get Taobao product reviews, scrape buyer feedback, extract reviews by item ID, or perform sentiment analysis on reviews.

say_en.text: Get reviews for this Taobao product with ID 123456789.
say_en.note: Claude will open the product page and extract reviews.

say_en.text: Fetch buyer reviews for this Tmall item, I want the latest 10.
say_en.note: Claude will paginate to get multiple pages of reviews.
